title: ttr-nlp rule pack
description: A rule pack: JAPE-shaped matching semantics in a declarative YAML surface (contracts §3). One pack is one YAML document. `additionalProperties: false` holds at every level — a typo must fail loudly at load rather than silently widen a match.

pack.description: Pack id (S-2 header). Unique across the loaded set.

version.description: Pack FORMAT version — tracks the schema major, not the pack's content.

phases.description: Phases run in file order. Each re-reads the annotation set, so a later phase sees what an earlier one added.

annType.description: An annotation type name — Token, Lookup, ORGANIZATION, QueryPattern, …

bindName.description: A name bound on the LHS and referenced from the RHS. Unique within a rule.

input.description: JAPE `Input:` — the ONLY annotation types this phase can see. Unlisted types are invisible and are matched ACROSS, which is the gap-skipping device that lets {Lookup}{Lookup} match with Tokens in between.

control.description: appelt: one rule fires per region, tie-broken longest -> priority -> file order. brill: all accepting matches fire, resume at max end. all: all fire, resume at next offset. first: first acceptance, no longest extension. once: the phase stops after one firing.

priority.description: Higher wins, but only AFTER longest-match under appelt.

lhs.description: A sequence of steps, matched in order.

rhs.description: What to do when the rule fires. Code-free by construction (P-2).

step.description: One matching step. Exactly one FORM key (ann | text | lemma | all | group | after | notafter | not), plus the modifiers `repeat` and `bind`. Kept as one flat object rather than a union of per-form schemas so that a mistyped key reports as a mistyped key, at its own path, instead of 'not valid under any of the given schemas'.

text.description: Shorthand: ann Token with a `text` feature constraint.

lemma.description: Shorthand: ann Token with a `lemma` feature constraint.

all.description: Conjunction at one position — JAPE `{A, !B}`. Members may use the `not` form.

after.description: Zero-width positive lookahead: required context, excluded from the match span.

not.description: Negation. Legal ONLY as a member of `all` — placement is checked by the model, which can say so in one sentence where the schema could only say 'no'.

features.description: Feature constraints on the matched annotation.

contains.description: The matched annotation must contain a match of this step.

within.description: The matched annotation must fall within a match of this step.

group.description: Alternation or an explicit sequence. Exactly one of `or` / `seq`.

items.description: One branch: a sequence of steps. An EMPTY branch would match the empty string and make the alternation vacuously true, so it is rejected.

or.description: At least two branches — a one-branch alternation is a `seq`.

repeat.description: Kleene/range repetition. Sugar `*` `+` `?` normalises to the object form.

max.description: Omitted or null means unbounded. `min > max` is unsatisfiable and is rejected by the model, which JSON Schema cannot express.

constraint.description: A feature constraint: a literal, or one of the operator objects.

action.description: Exactly one of `add` / `update`. There is no third option and no code (P-2).

span.description: Span of the new annotation. Default: the whole match.

set.description: Target annotation set. Default: the working set.

featureValue.description: A literal, or a getter reading from a bound step.

get.description: `@string` = the span's text, `@length` = its character length, anything else = a feature of the bound annotation.
